en: Black‑and‑white image showing a forest path running along a rocky outcrop on the left, with rustic wooden benches and railings on both sides of the trail. A wooden shelter or pavilion is partly visible against the rock. Tall coniferous and deciduous trees fill the background. A woman in long, late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century dress and hat stands by the railing, looking toward the view. There is no visible printed text on the front.
